# EchelonFox

> EchelonFox provides commercial growth strategy and implementation for established companies. It works with leaders of proven companies whose growth has outpaced their systems: it identifies the commercial constraint that matters most, then connects positioning, customer acquisition, sales processes, and technology into a clearer way to grow.

## About

EchelonFox reads how a business makes money, finds the constraint holding growth back, designs a better commercial system, and leads the work to build it. The experience behind it includes enterprise B2B sales, founding a startup acquired by Staples, and operations.

Engagements follow four stages: Diagnose → Design → Build → Improve. Websites, SEO, campaigns, CRM workflows, and AI tools are parts of a solution, chosen after the commercial problem is diagnosed.

- [About](https://echelonfox.com/about): We find the gaps that hold a growing business back, in how it sells, markets, and operates, then lead the work to fix them.
- [Contact](https://echelonfox.com/contact): Send a message or book a call.

## Services

- [Commercial diagnosis and positioning](https://echelonfox.com/services/commercial-diagnosis): Sales and customer analysis, segmentation, positioning, and measurement.
- [Customer acquisition and conversion](https://echelonfox.com/services/customer-acquisition): Websites, search, local visibility, Google Shopping, and paid media.
- [Sales process, CRM, and follow-up](https://echelonfox.com/services/sales-process-crm): CRM setup, pipeline design, and lifecycle email and SMS.
- [Practical AI and automation](https://echelonfox.com/services/ai-automation): Lead response, scheduling, CRM workflows, follow-up, and admin automation, with human handoff.

## Work & Insights

- [Work](https://echelonfox.com/work): Case studies in the format asked for → broader issue found → what was built → outcome where evidence exists.
- [Insights](https://echelonfox.com/insights): Practical guides on local SEO, AI search, and growth.
